_comment: THE TOWN CALENDAR — fully authored (Layer 0). Validated by bake-content.js#validateEvents, read by src/hooks/useEvents.js through the `seedEvents` seam in loadInstanceData, rendered by EventTicker in amber.

_schema.title: REQUIRED. The headline. On a town event this is the bold line.
_schema.end_date: Optional; defaults to start_date. An event with dates and NO times is active all day, every day, across the range — that is the whole point of a town event.
_schema.start_time: Optional HH:MM. ⛔ Supplying start_time AND end_time makes the event clock-dependent, so it disappears outside those hours. Omit both for an all-day run.
_schema.id: REQUIRED on a TOWN event (one with no listing_id), and unique. Without it every town event collides on a single key and they overwrite each other.
_schema.listing_id: Optional. Present = the event is ABOUT that place and REPLACES its open-now ticker entry. This is the guardian channel's shape.
_schema.links_to: Optional. Where the event SENDS you — the sponsor, the venue, whoever the operator chose. ⛔ Never the key: two festivals sponsored by one marina are still two festivals. Must resolve to a listing id in this scene or the bake refuses.
_schema.description: Optional. On a town event this is the sub-line under the title.
_schema.type: Optional 'recurring' + recurrence:'weekly' + day_of_week:'saturday' for a farmers market.
_schema._source: Convention, not schema: any _-prefixed key is provenance and never ships.
